No, I am not a Mixture of Experts (MoE) model. I am a dense transformer-based language model, which means that all of my parameters are used for every token prediction. In contrast, MoE models selectively activate only a subset of their parameters (the "experts") for each token, which can make them more computationally efficient for certain tasks.
